name: Premera Blue Cross

internationalCoverage.overview: Premera Blue Cross serves Washington state and Alaska. As a BCBS licensee, Premera provides international coverage through the BCBS Global Core program. Premera specifically advises members to contact them before international travel to understand their coverage.

planDifferences.description: PPO plans cover international emergency and urgent care through Global Core at out-of-network rates. Heritage plans (HMO-like) cover emergencies only. Premera Medicare Advantage plans cover worldwide emergency and urgent care subject to a lifetime limit.

covered: Emergency care via BCBS Global Core
Premera Medicare Advantage: worldwide emergency coverage (capped)

alerts.title: Call Before You Go
alerts.message: Premera specifically recommends calling them before international travel. They can explain exactly what your plan covers abroad and help you prepare. Contact Premera Customer Service or call BCBS Global Core collect at 804-673-1177 from abroad.

alerts.title: Coverage May Differ
alerts.message: Premera notes that 'coverage outside the United States may be different.' Some plans only cover emergency care outside the service area. Verify your specific plan.

supplementalInsurance.details: Recommended. Standard BCBS Global Core emergency coverage is decent, but Premera's WA/AK focus means most plans are optimized for domestic care. Supplemental insurance fills the gaps for international travel.

questionsToAsk: What international coverage does my specific Premera plan include?
Is my plan a PPO or heritage plan — and how does that affect international coverage?
Does my plan cover urgent care abroad or only emergencies?
How do I reach BCBS Global Core from abroad?
